profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Upstart | ex-Mckinsey
profile.summary: I am a technical leader, architect, and full stack developer with over 20 years of experience designing and developing large scale web and mobile platforms.  My passion is leading organizational transformation through the implementation of DevOps, modern cloud first patterns, Agile methodologies, and digital recruitment.

positions.title: Managing Director, Principal Engineer for Web and Mobile
Associate Partner, Senior Digital Expert
positions.description:
Associate partner advancing the agenda of oil & gas and public utility practices.  Focus on building new “digital muscles” that realize the value of agile, design thinking, and modern technology to advance client objectives.  Led technical implementations at several public utilities and oil & gas clients.

Further, designed, led delivery, and promoted cloud acceleration framework that creates a best in class Azure enterprise framework.  A fully scripted, operationally stable, secure Azure estate is instantiated and can evolve over time in a testable manner through infrastructure as code.  Decreased delivery time in engagements by 10-16 weeks.

positions.title: Digital Expert
positions.description:
Senior architect and full stack developer for a variety of clients.

•	Led implementation of e-commerce recovery project that delivered a re-platform of the client’s main web presence in five months.  Inherited code from 3rd party and implemented new Scrum process, Agile engineering practices (GitHub Flow, CI/CD, code reviews, automated testing), and novel AWS based customer testing techniques.  Technologies involved were React, Redux, .Net WebAPIs, Node.js, SQL Server, CloudFront, Route53, Braintree, PayPal.

•	Led development efforts at a large solar utility to instill a digital first mindset and deliver their first holistic operational dashboard to drive strategic business efforts.  Digitized form inputs across dozens of installations, developed ETL solution, relational database, and Tableau dashboards.

•	Designed customer messaging platform for a Midwest public utility that enabled two-way communication with customers during outages and emergencies.  Developed solution using Twilio, Java Spring Boot based services, KUBRA, and a set of AWS services (SQS, ECS, RDS, SES) that supported messaging via IVR, SMS, and email to millions of customers.  Successfully established a cloud platform team, DevOps pipelines (CI/CD), infrastructure as code, and upskilled engineers.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
Several roles including: 

Senior architect of a microservice platform that rapidly delivers custom applications focused on the visualization of complex data.  Delivered a custom dashboard solution in as little as two weeks by leveraging microservices to compose an application that is delivered through Angular-based SPAs.  The platform supported over a hundred clients.
•	Architect and led development of services.  Portfolio includes solutions in Rails, Java, Clojure, Node.js, .Net.
•	Led technical discussions in discovery and inception phases of projects to negotiate with business stakeholders and product owners and gauge the suitability of their products for the platform.
•	Coached and mentored team of designers, front-end developers, service developers, and full stack engineers 

Architected and led development of suite of application that supported lean construction practices for large (billion+) construction projects.  Collaborated with a Moroccan client to design a suite of products that allowed near real time capture of gaps between planning and execution of construction.
•	Suite of products included Tableau control tower dashboards, a supervisor/planner web application, and a mobile cross platform application with offline capabilities.
•	Coordinated a team that spanned the US, India, Morocco, and Italy to develop the application with roughly a dozen developers and roll out to over 250 construction personnel.

Architect and technical lead for implementation of new McKinsey.com Sitecore-based website that included all main site content, McKinsey Quarterly assets, and careers site.  Led a team of 15 designers, developers, and infrastructure personnel to implement a Sitecore best practices driven site in 10 months.

volunteerExperiences.description: Organized and participated in several national and local volunteer service projects, along with daily mentoring and tutoring of children ages 7-16 (over 900 hours of community service).
